summary: Practise nodal analysis, well surveillance, and artificial-lift screening in a five-day course. Explore the outline and enrol.
lede: Oil and gas production technology helps production engineers, petroleum technologists, and operations supervisors diagnose well performance and locate constraints. The course develops practical skills in PVT interpretation, nodal analysis, well-test validation, artificial-lift screening, and production surveillance, so participants can compare inflow and outflow behaviour, distinguish well or reservoir limits from facility bottlenecks, and prepare optimization and intervention recommendations.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who assess, operate, or support producing oil and gas wells and facilities.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to petroleum engineering, production operations, or producing-well data is expected. Basic familiarity with well rates, pressure, and fluid properties will help you complete the exercises. Coding is not required; exercises use production concepts and Excel-based data review.
